display.purpose: Hero and major section headings only, always uppercase, never with a kicker above it.

label.purpose: Nav items, buttons, chips, form labels — bold, tracked, uppercase.

shadows.name: brand-mark-glow
shadows.purpose: The only soft-blur shadow in the system, reserved for the hero-scale brand mark.

motion.name: hover-standard
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus transition for buttons, links, and nav items.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default CTA — transparent fill, periwinkle border/text, sharp corners, fills solid periwinkle with near-black text on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #7AA2F7; border: 1px solid #7AA2F7; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #7AA2F7; color: #11121A; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7AA2F7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Single highest-priority CTA per section — solid periwinkle fill, near-black text, sharp corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { background: #7AA2F7; color: #11121A; border: none; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-solid:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2F4FC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Service/project card — surface background, hairline periwinkle border, sharp-ish small radius, optional top accent line for featured cards.
components.html:
Desarrollo de Aplicaciones

Aplicaciones web, móviles y de escritorio a medida.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: #171923; border: 1px solid rgba(122,162,247,0.15); border-radius: 6px; padding: 24px 32px; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(122,162,247,0.3); } .ds-card-accent { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(122,162,247,0.4), transparent); } .ds-card h3 { color: #F2F4FC; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card p { color: #98A2C7; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field — surface background, hairline periwinkle border, rounded corners, periwinkle focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #171923; color: #F2F4FC; border: 1px solid rgba(122,162,247,0.2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #98A2C7; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #7AA2F7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #7AA2F7; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Fixed dark bar, hairline periwinkle bottom border, periwinkle wordmark + isotipo, nav links inherit currentColor icons.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #11121A; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(122,162,247,0.15); padding: 12px 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav-brand-thin { color: #7AA2F7; font-weight: 200; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-nav-brand-bold { color: #7AA2F7; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-nav-link { color: #98A2C7; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #F2F4FC; }

components.name: Brand Mark Hero
components.description: Hero-scale isotipo treatment — periwinkle-ringed circle, radial glow, drop-shadowed owl mark. The signature component of the system.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { position: relative; width: 320px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 9999px; background: #171923; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 2px solid rgba(122,162,247,0.3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-brand-mark-glow { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(122,162,247,0.14), transparent 70%); } .ds-brand-mark-icon { position: relative; width: 55%; height: auto; fill: #7AA2F7; filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 28px rgba(122,162,247,0.35)); }

narrative.overview: OwlCode is a solo developer's brand carried by one mark and two colors: a periwinkle (#7AA2F7) owl-with-circuit-motif on near-black (#11121A), with nothing else competing for attention. The system replaces an earlier ad-hoc "Blueprint" theme (cyan accent, gold CTA, Oswald type) with a locked, designer-specified identity: the brand's own manual fixes the palette and typography, and this build treats that manual as ground truth rather than a starting point to riff on. Roboto's ExtraLight/Bold contrast — thin, wide display type against bold, tracked labels — does the expressive work that color is not allowed to do, since periwinkle is the only accent in the system, full stop, including status indicators.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, no exceptions — not for status dots, not for a "just this once" second hue.
Sharp-cornered CTAs against rounded inputs, icon buttons, and chips — a deliberate, consistent split, not an inconsistency.
Thin ExtraLight display type paired with bold, uppercase, wide-tracked labels — the type pairing carries hierarchy instead of color.
No kicker/eyebrow lines above headings, even where the source brand mockup used one — the heading always carries its own weight.
The brand mark itself (isotipo) is usable as hero-scale imagery, not just a small nav glyph — it is confident enough to anchor a first viewport on its own.

rules.name: The Sole Accent Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle is the only accent color anywhere in the interface — including semantic status dots. The one deliberate exception is the contact form's error state, which uses a restrained red because error semantics are a near-universal usability affordance, not a brand accent.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small label, eyebrow, or tagline sits above a heading. Identity or context information that would have lived in a kicker belongs in the nav, the copy itself, or is simply dropped.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels never carry a box-shadow. A hairline border and a background-color step (surface vs. blueprint) are the entire depth vocabulary for content containers.

rules.name: The Sharp CTA Rule
rules.body: Buttons that trigger an action are always sharp-cornered rectangles — zero border-radius. Everything else (inputs, icon buttons, chips, the mobile menu panel) is rounded.

dos: Do use periwinkle (#7AA2F7) as the only accent, everywhere.
Do keep CTA buttons sharp-cornered while inputs, icon buttons, and chips stay rounded.
Do use Roboto ExtraLight for display headlines and Roboto Bold for labels/buttons — no other typeface.
Do build depth with hairline borders, background-color steps, and (for the brand mark only) a soft glow/drop-shadow.
Do tint secondary text from the periwinkle hue (ink-muted), never plain gray.
donts: Don't introduce a second or third accent hue for any reason.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow line above a heading, even if a reference mockup shows one.
Don't hardcode icon stroke colors as #fff/#ffffff; use currentColor.
Don't drop unrecolored, full-color stock illustration onto a brand-critical screen — integrate it into the two-color system or replace it with the brand mark itself.
